description: Each event is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body and these headers: Shop-Webhook-Id (the event id, the same on every retry: use it to ignore duplicates), Shop-Webhook-Timestamp (Unix seconds when this attempt was signed), Shop-Webhook-Signature (v1= followed by the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the raw body, keyed by the endpoint's signing secret, whsec_ included, as UTF-8), Content-Type: application/json and User-Agent: ShopBot-Webhooks/1. Verify the signature over the raw bytes before parsing, compare it in constant time, and refuse a timestamp more than 5 minutes from your clock. Answer with any 2xx status within 5 seconds; anything else, a redirect included, is retried with backoff for 24 hours. Delivery is at least once, and events may arrive out of order. Rotating the secret replaces it at once: there is no period in which both secrets are valid, except that a delivery already being sent at that moment may still arrive signed with the old secret. New fields and event types may be added within v1: ignore what you do not know.
